input.strategy_title: Disconnected environment guidance for KServe raw deployment mode
input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Raw deployment mode is the recommended KServe path for disconnected clusters,
but our documentation only covers serverless mode installs. Field teams keep
rediscovering the same steps — which images to mirror, which operators to skip,
how to verify an air-gapped install — in private gists. Nothing in this
strategy changes product behavior; the capability exists and works. The gap is
entirely published guidance.

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P1 | A disconnected install guide for KServe raw deployment mode exists in the product documentation, covering prerequisites, operator configuration, and validation steps. |
| HLR-2 | P1 | The guide includes a complete image-mirroring reference (required images and how to derive the digest list per release). |
| HLR-3 | P2 | A troubleshooting section covers the three most common field-reported failure modes (image pull errors, missing runtime, storage-initializer misconfiguration). |

## Affected Components

- KServe
- Documentation

## Out of Scope

- Any code, operator, or default-configuration change
- Serverless mode disconnected support

## Open Questions

None — source material exists in field enablement docs; this is authoring and
technical review work.

# Disconnected environment guidance for KServe raw deployment mode — documentation authoring

## Description

Author and publish a disconnected-environment install guide for KServe raw
deployment mode in the product documentation. The capability already exists and
works in the product; the gap is entirely published guidance. Field teams
currently rediscover the required steps — which images to mirror, which
operators to skip, how to verify an air-gapped install — from private gists and
field enablement material. This epic converts that existing source material
into maintained product documentation.

No product behavior changes: no code, operator, or default-configuration
changes are in scope. Serverless-mode disconnected support is explicitly out of
scope.

## Scope

Author a single disconnected install guide for KServe raw deployment mode,
structured as follows (content outline):

1. **Prerequisites** — requirements for a disconnected cluster targeting raw
   deployment mode, including the mirror registry setup needed before install.
2. **Operator configuration** — which operators to install and which to skip
   for raw deployment mode in a disconnected environment (the mode uses plain
   Deployments/Services with no mesh dependency, so serverless-only operators
   are skipped).
3. **Image-mirroring reference** — the complete list of required images for a
   disconnected install, and the procedure for deriving the digest list per
   release.
4. **Validation steps** — how to verify a successful air-gapped install of
   KServe raw deployment mode.
5. **Troubleshooting** — a section covering the three most common
   field-reported failure modes: image pull errors, missing runtime, and
   storage-initializer misconfiguration.

Source material exists in field enablement docs; this epic is authoring and
technical review work, not research.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Given** a disconnected cluster, **when** a user follows the published
  guide, **then** they can complete a KServe raw deployment mode install
  (prerequisites, operator configuration, validation) — measured by the guide
  existing in the product documentation with all three sections present and
  technically reviewed. (HLR-1)
- **Given** the guide, **when** a user prepares their mirror registry,
  **then** it contains a complete image-mirroring reference listing the
  required images and documenting how to derive the digest list per release —
  measured by technical review confirming the image list matches the shipped
  release. (HLR-2)
- **Given** the guide, **when** a user hits one of the three most common
  field-reported failure modes (image pull errors, missing runtime,
  storage-initializer misconfiguration), **then** the troubleshooting section
  covers it — measured by the section covering all three named failure modes.
  (HLR-3)
- **Accuracy validation (mandatory):** the guide's claims about KServe raw
  deployment mode are validated against the platform architecture context —
  in particular that raw deployment mode (plain Deployments/Services, no mesh
  dependency) is the recommended path for disconnected environments, that
  Service Mesh / Serverless operators are serverless-mode-only dependencies,
  and that Serving Runtimes provide model execution. The guide must not
  contradict the architecture context.
- **Technical review:** the published guide is technically reviewed against
  the actual implementation by the KServe owning team before publication.
- No code, operator, or default-configuration changes are introduced by this
  work.

## HLR Traceability

| HLR | Priority | Coverage |
|-----|----------|----------|
| HLR-1 | P1 | Disconnected install guide (prerequisites, operator configuration, validation steps) — fully covered |
| HLR-2 | P1 | Image-mirroring reference (required images, per-release digest derivation) — fully covered |
| HLR-3 | P2 | Troubleshooting section for the three named failure modes — fully covered |

All three HLRs are covered by this single epic; the strategy was triaged as
documentation-only, so no priority-based split is applied.
